title: Left-growth sweep span
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite alphabet and let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$ with $k$ work tapes. Choose $a_0\in\Gamma$, an optional source state, and a Boolean head flag for each tape. For any input-head position, output word, integer frontier $z$, and left and right stacks $l,r$, the augmented simulator, starting in its indexed left-growth phase at counter zero, reaches after $k$ steps the same phase with counter $k$ and frontier $z-k$. Its left stack is the row determined by the given head flags, encoded as sweep symbols and prepended to $l$; its right stack is $r$ with its first $k$ entries removed. The work-tape head stays between $z-k$ and $z$, inclusive, throughout.
